items.title: Youth Summer Series Writing Workshop: World-Building and Lived Experiences
items.summary: Join authors Sarena and Sasha Nanua for an Author Talk and interactive workshop, “World-Building and Writing from your Lived Experiences.”

items.title: Mississauga Hong Kong Festival 2026
items.summary: The Mississauga Hong Kong Festival 2026 takes over the Paramount Fine Foods Centre Sportsplex on August 15 and 16, bringing the city's most authentic Hong Kong experience to life. Feel the energy of the World Kongers Cup soccer competition, now joined by a brand new basketball tournament that draws players from across Ontario and beyond. Between the matches, hit up a vibrant market with tasty Hong Kong street food, nostalgic games, and handmade crafts.

items.title: Japan Festival Canada
items.summary: Celebrate the beauty and depth of Japan through a dynamic festival that blends timeless culture with modern creativity. From captivating performances to immersive experiences, this is your chance to explore Japan in the heart of the city. Enjoy live entertainment, cultural demonstrations, and a variety of authentic Japanese cuisine. Discover traditional arts, contemporary pop culture, and unique vendors offering everything from handcrafted goods to the latest trends.

items.title: Summer Berry Salad
items.summary: Join us for an interactive, hands-on workshop that reconnects participants to the earth through the lens of Indigenous food sovereignty.

items.title: Water & Urban Gardening: Hacks for Hydration
items.summary: Explore how healthy soil and smart gardening practices can help conserve water while supporting thriving urban gardens.

items.title: Mississauga Italfest 2026
items.summary: Mississauga Italfest is a vibrant celebration of Italian culture in Mississauga. Recognized as one of Ontario’s Top 100 Festivals (2016–2025), the festival takes place each August in celebration of Ferragosto, Italy’s national holiday. The festival brings the community together for a lively weekend filled with live music, traditional and contemporary performances, and authentic Italian cuisine—from fresh pasta and pizza to espresso and cannoli.

items.title: Kendra Gabrielle
items.summary: Get ready for an unforgettable evening of live music as Kendra Gabrielle , one of Canada's rising country-pop stars, takes the stage in Mississauga! With over 500,000 music streams and a rapidly growing community of 13,000+ social media followers , Kendra Gabrielle is capturing the attention of audiences across Canada with her heartfelt songwriting, powerful vocals, and dynamic stage presence.
